messages.context: 首次与后续招呼；保留 Carnival Fisherman 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Welcome to §3Catch a Fish§f, friend!
messages.text: Welcome to Catch a Fish, friend!
messages.gloss: Catch a Fish 沿用本 NPC 与 Hub_General/ScoreBoard/Common_Sidebar.json#sb_carnival_catch_a_fish 的既有译名：钓鱼大赛。Wiki 首段为 §f，实测 raw 无显式起始颜色；引擎读取实时样式。
messages.zh: 欢迎来到钓鱼大赛,朋友!

messages.context: 门票足够，玩家同意开局；保留运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Well, here goes...
messages.text: Well, here goes...
messages.zh: 好,那就开始吧……

messages.context: 开始游戏前祝好运；保留运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Good luck, friend!
messages.text: Good luck, friend!
messages.zh: 祝你好运,朋友!

messages.context: 玩家要求再讲一遍规则；保留运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Of course!
messages.text: Of course!
messages.zh: 当然!

messages.context: 首次及重复讲解限时钓鱼规则；保留运行时实测台词
messages.raw: You will be given §a100s §fto catch some §3fish §fwith a §7fishing rod §fI will provide you.
messages.text: You will be given 100s to catch some fish with a fishing rod I will provide you.
messages.gloss: 100s 是固定游戏时限，不是倒计时变量。fishing rod 沿用本地 GUI_Item 整名译文：Hub_General/GUI_Item/Fishing_Merchant.json#fishing_rod（Fishing Rod → 钓鱼竿）。Wiki 首次讲解 fish 为 §b，重复讲解为 §3；词义与分段边界相同，复用一条记录并读取实时颜色，保留实测 raw。
messages.zh: 你有 100 秒的时间去钓鱼,使用的钓鱼竿由我提供。

messages.context: 首次及重复讲解鱼的颜色与分值；保留运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Each type of §3fish §fhas a different §ccolor §fand §apoint value§f.
messages.text: Each type of fish has a different color and point value.
messages.gloss: Wiki 首次讲解 fish 为 §b，重复讲解为 §3；同文复用，中文鱼、颜色、分值分别读取对应实时样式。保留实测 raw。
messages.zh: 每种鱼都有不同的颜色和分值。

messages.context: 首次及重复提醒在限时内多钓鱼；保留运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Try to catch as many as you can before the §ctime§f runs out.
messages.text: Try to catch as many as you can before the time runs out.
messages.gloss: Wiki 首次讲解为全白，重复讲解把 time 与其后的空格标红；实测只把 time 标红。保留实测颜色边界；同一句对白复用，中文时间读取实时颜色，后段从 runs 的可见文字读取白色。
messages.zh: 尽量在时间耗尽前多钓些鱼。

messages.text: I'll be waiting here if you change your mind.

messages.raw: Are you here to play?
messages.text: Are you here to play?
messages.zh: 你是来参加游戏的吗?

messages.context: 询问玩家是否参加钓鱼大赛
messages.raw: Would you like to play?
messages.text: Would you like to play?
messages.zh: 你想参加游戏吗?

messages.context: 首次互动，感谢 Foxy 市长允许借池塘办游戏
messages.raw: §fMayor Foxy graciously allowed me to use this §bpond §ffor my attraction.
messages.text: Mayor Foxy graciously allowed me to use this pond for my attraction.
messages.gloss: Foxy 是市长人名，保留英文；attraction 在这里指他经营的嘉年华小游戏。
messages.zh: Foxy 市长真是好心,肯把这片池塘借给我办游戏。

messages.zh: 好了,游戏规则是这样的:

messages.raw: §fSo, interested in playing?
messages.text: So, interested in playing?
messages.zh: 怎么样,想试试吗?

messages.context: 玩家同意参加，但没有游戏所需的 5 张嘉年华门票
messages.raw: §fSorry friend, but it looks like you don't have the 5x §aCarnival Tickets §frequired to play...
messages.text: Sorry friend, but it looks like you don't have the 5x Carnival Tickets required to play...
messages.gloss: 所需物品 Carnival Tickets 使用本地单数整名译文：Hub_General/GUI_Item/Carnival_Ticket.json#carnival_ticket_name（Carnival Ticket → 嘉年华门票）。5 张是固定开局门槛，不是动态数量；不改为货币或其他票券。
messages.zh: 抱歉,朋友,你好像没带够玩一局所需的 5 张嘉年华门票……

segments.text: Sorry friend, but it looks like you don't have the 5x
segments.zh: 抱歉,朋友,你好像没带够玩一局所需的 5 张

messages.context: 玩家缺少门票，提议下次再玩；复用 CHAT 同文
首次邀请时玩家选择 Maybe later，表示仍会在这里等候
messages.raw: §fI'll be waiting here if you change your mind again.
messages.text: I'll be waiting here if you change your mind again.
messages.gloss: Wiki 首次拒绝的版本含 again；后续拒绝及基线实测无 again，两个原文版本均保留，不跨消息合并。
messages.zh: 要是你又改主意了,我还在这儿等你。

messages.context: 嘉年华已经结束，玩家仍尝试参加
messages.raw: §fAww, the Carnival is closing for the year now. There's always a next time!
messages.text: Aww, the Carnival is closing for the year now. There's always a next time!
messages.gloss: Carnival 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的嘉年华；for the year 是当前年度结束，不写死具体年份或承诺确切下次开放时间。
messages.zh: 唉,今年的嘉年华要收摊了。不过还有下次嘛!

messages.context: 服务器卡顿，无法开始游戏
messages.raw: §fThis server's as slow as reeling in a heavy catch, can't play the game like this. Sorry, friend!
messages.text: This server's as slow as reeling in a heavy catch, can't play the game like this. Sorry, friend!
messages.gloss: 用拉一条很重的鱼作慢速比喻，保留钓鱼摊主的词汇场；不补偿门票、不虚构等待或换服指令。
messages.zh: 这服务器慢得像在跟一条大鱼较劲,这样可玩不了。抱歉,朋友!

note: 身份：嘉年华钓鱼大赛的摊主，负责招呼玩家、讲规则与开局。关系：对来客友善，常称朋友，不擅自写成熟人关系。说话风格：朴素随和，讲规则清楚直白，拒绝时略带遗憾。性格与词汇：热爱钓鱼，把钓鱼当艺术，连服务器卡顿也用拉大鱼来打比方。禁用风格：不写官腔、伪文言、粗口或无来由的网络梗；人名 Foxy 保留英文。
